item.title: Parenting in the AI age: what kids can (and can't) do with AI
item.description:
Today's issue of the WFH Dads newsletter asks the question on a lot of parents' minds: are your kids using AI? The piece walks through what kids can — and can't — meaningfully do with AI tools, drawing on the author's own experience watching his children engage with them, plus a recommended AI podcast for further listening.

The underlying tension is one every work-from-home parent will recognize: AI is already woven into the devices and apps kids touch daily, and the gap between a child's experimentation and a parent's understanding is widening fast. The practical takeaway isn't a specific tool or rule, but a posture — get curious about what your kids are actually doing with AI before deciding what you think about it. That conversation is the whole point.
